title: 第七章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

脑海中浮现出那日在火车站见到的女同志。

也不知道她找到自己亲人了没。

郑团见他这样，当即明白了什么，哈哈一笑，“你心里有数就行，我不跟你说了。”

苏清荔还不知道自己就吃个饭的功夫，就被扣上不安分的标签。

此刻她正琢磨着，要去招待所一趟。

毕竟她行李还在那里呢。

于是这天下午，苏清荔找到王兵，“咱们这到火车站的车，都是几点出发？”

“车？”王兵想了想，“早晚六点钟都有去火车站的大巴，不过你去那里干吗？”

苏清荔解释自己想买点生活用品。

“嗨，那你坐小周的车不就行了？”王兵说，“他下午刚好要到集市上买菜。”

小周是炊事班的炊事员，由于人手不够，所以也负责上外面采购。

他父母都在国营企业上班，为人踏实，管得又是厨房，油水最大的地方。

部队里很多姑娘都挺中意他。

只是小周这人看似随和，但却跟异性保持距离。

昨天却明里暗里的跟他打听苏清荔。

王兵看出他对苏清荔有好感，就顺水推舟一把。

苏清荔想了想，她留在招待所的东西挺多的，一个人是不太方便，就同意了。

小周得知自己要和苏清荔单独出门，高兴得耳根都红了。

回头我请你吃饭！

王兵看懂这小子的唇语后，笑了笑，觉得自己做了件好事。

而另一边，小周跟苏清荔出门时，就绞尽脑汁想着话题。

“苏同志，你平时没事的话都做什么？”

“做什么？”

苏清荔想了想，傅大山和苏云如平时都很宠她，她平时除了唱歌，练练基本功外，基本就是十指不沾阳春水。

“好像什么都不做。”她诚实回答道。

闻言，小周也没气馁。

又问：“那你有什么爱好吗？”

“喜欢吃东西算吗？”

小周愣了一下，随即笑了笑。

“算。”他会做饭，苏清荔爱吃，何尝不是一种合适呢？

Page (1/3)

The lesbian I met at the train station that day came to mind.

I don’t know if she has found her relatives.

When Zheng Tuan saw him like this, he immediately understood something and laughed, "As long as you know what's going on, I won't tell you anymore."

Su Qingli didn't even know that she was labeled as restless just because she was just eating.

At this moment, she was thinking about going to the guest house.

After all, her luggage is still there.

So that afternoon, Su Qingli asked Wang Bing, "What time does our train to the train station leave?"

"Car?" Wang Bing thought for a while, "There are buses to the train station at six o'clock in the morning and evening, but why are you going there?"

Su Qingli explained that she wanted to buy some daily necessities.

"Hey, can't you just take Xiao Zhou's car?" Wang Bing said, "He happens to be going to the market to buy vegetables in the afternoon."

Xiao Zhou is a cook in the cooking class. Due to the shortage of manpower, he is also responsible for purchasing outside.

Both of his parents work in state-owned enterprises. They are down-to-earth people and manage the kitchen, which is the most lucrative place.

Many girls in the army liked him very much.

It's just that Xiao Zhou seems to be an easy-going person, but he keeps a distance from the opposite sex.

Yesterday, she asked him about Su Qingli openly and secretly.

Wang Bing saw that he had a good impression of Su Qingli, so he pushed him along.

Su Qingli thought for a while, she had quite a lot of things left at the guest house, and it was not convenient for her to be alone, so she agreed.

Xiao Zhou was so happy that his ears turned red when he learned that he and Su Qingli were going out alone.

I'll treat you to dinner later!

After Wang Bing understood the boy's lips, he smiled and felt that he had done a good thing.

On the other side, when Xiao Zhou and Su Qingli went out, they racked their brains to think about topics.

"Comrade Su, what do you do when you have nothing to do?"

"What to do?"

Su Qingli thought about it. Fu Dashan and Su Yunru usually doted on her. Apart from singing and practicing basic skills, she basically kept her fingers free of Yang Chun Shui.

"It doesn't seem to be doing anything," she answered honestly.

Hearing this, Xiao Zhou was not discouraged.

Then asked: "What are your hobbies?"

"Does it count if you like to eat?"

Xiao Zhou was stunned for a moment, then smiled.

"Forget it." He can cook, and Su Qingli loves to eat, so why not?
